resources.description: Geolocate an IPv4/IPv6 address: country, region, city, postcode, lat/lng, timezone, ISP, org, ASN, and a datacenter heuristic.
Great-circle distance (km and miles) between two IP addresses, with each endpoint's city/country/lat/lng.
Geolocate the caller's own IP (derived from request headers); same fields as /lookup/ip.
Batch geolocation for up to 20 IP addresses in one call; returns a per-IP record matching /lookup/ip.
